assessmentBasis.creativeConcept: 髪を無理に変える前に、今の状態から一緒に整え方を考える、大人の相談型サロン。
assessmentBasis.comparisonObservation: UI/UX Pro Max raw recommendation was materially identical to Lumi Yokohama despite different concept/query.

candidates.recommendation: Hero + Testimonials + CTA; Hero > Problem statement > Solution overview > Testimonials carousel > CTA
reasons: Social proof is compatible with review evidence, but the exact section formula is an industry-generic conversion pattern.
The identical recommendation for Lumi shows insufficient store specificity.
candidates.revisionInstruction: Do not adopt the section formula unchanged. Rebuild section order from girasol evidence, consultation-led concept, and information priority.

candidates.recommendation: Soft UI Evolution with subtle depth, improved shadows, hybrid modern aesthetics
reasons: The style is described as suitable for enterprise/SaaS/health/wellness rather than being derived from girasol evidence.
The same style was returned for Lumi.
candidates.revisionInstruction: Use only the low-noise/subtle-depth principle if it supports the calm consultation concept; do not make Soft UI the governing visual style.

reasons: Known girasol direction is deep muted green + warm ivory, derived from the adult calm consultation concept.
Pink/lavender is a generic beauty recommendation and was identically returned for Lumi.
candidates.revisionInstruction: Reject palette. Retain girasol evidence-led deep muted green / warm ivory direction unless newer store evidence justifies revision.

reasons: Editorial sophistication may support an adult premium tone, but the pair was not derived from store-specific evidence and was also returned for Lumi.
candidates.revisionInstruction: Treat as a candidate only. Compare against a calmer, less fashion-editorial typography direction before Visual Direction is fixed.

candidates.recommendation: Text contrast 4.5:1 minimum, visible keyboard focus, keyboard-accessible controls, prefers-reduced-motion support
reasons: These are cross-store UX/accessibility guardrails and are expected to remain consistent.

candidates.recommendation: Validate responsive behavior at 375px, 768px, 1024px, and 1440px; clickable elements need clear pointer/interaction states
reasons: Responsive and interaction QA are production-wide fixed requirements rather than store creative decisions.
